metaDescription: Order custom white lanyards for your event or team. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints. Get a quote today!
introHtml: White lanyards offer a clean, neutral backdrop that makes your printed logo or message stand out clearly. Whether you need 3/4" woven polyester for a trade show or antimicrobial lanyards for a healthcare setting, white provides a professional look that pairs with any uniform or badge color. The light surface also means less ink coverage for full-color designs, which can reduce decoration costs on large orders.
heroAltText: Custom white lanyards with printed logos for events, schools, and corporate use.
